```plato
//==
// # Transforms
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Affine and projective transform operations
//  - Elementary transforms
//  - Frame and basis operations
//  - Transform identity statics
//  - Motor operations
//  - Point support
//  - Rigid pose operations
//  - Rotation operations and conversions
//  - TRS transform operations

library Transforms
{
    //==
    // # Affine and projective transform operations
    //
    // Application, composition, inversion, and the widening conversions into the
    // affine and projective transforms of `transforms.types.plato` — the common
    // ground where transforms of different kinds are composed.

    //==
    // Affine transforms — the general linear-plus-translation maps; the common
    // ground every 2D/3D transform above converts into, and the right place to
    // compose mixed transform kinds.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Affine_transformation

    // Apply the affine map to a point (includes the translation row).
    Transform(p: Point2D, a: AffineTransform2D): Point2D
        => p.PositionVector.Transform(a.Matrix).ToPoint;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): a * p.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
        => Transform(p, a);

    // Apply the linear part to a displacement (translation does not act on
    // vectors).
    Transform(v: Vector2D, a: AffineTransform2D): Vector2D
        => v.TransformNormal(a.Matrix);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): a * v.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform2D, v: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => Transform(v, a);

    // The affine transform that applies `first`, then `second` (row-vector
    // matrix product).
    Compose(first: AffineTransform2D, second: AffineTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(first.Matrix * second.Matrix);

    // Alias for Compose, enabling the * operator: a * b applies a first.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform2D, b: AffineTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => a.Compose(b);

    // The inverse map. Precondition: CanInvert (a non-zero determinant).
    Inverse(a: AffineTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(a.Matrix.Invert.X0);

    // True when the affine map is invertible (non-zero determinant).
    CanInvert(a: AffineTransform2D): Boolean
        => a.Matrix.Invert.X1;

    // Any TRS transform is affine.
    AffineTransform2D(t: TrsTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(t.Matrix3x2);

    // Any rigid pose is affine.
    AffineTransform2D(pose: Pose2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(pose.Matrix3x2);

    // Any plane rotation is affine.
    AffineTransform2D(r: Rotation2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(r.Matrix3x2);

    // The 3D affine matrix widened to homogeneous form (fourth column 0,0,0,1).
    Matrix4x4(a: AffineTransform3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var m = a.Matrix;
        return (Number4(m.Row1.X, m.Row1.Y, m.Row1.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row2.X, m.Row2.Y, m.Row2.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y, m.Row3.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row4.X, m.Row4.Y, m.Row4.Z, 1.0));
    }

    // The affine part of a homogeneous matrix. Precondition: the matrix has no
    // projective component (its fourth column is 0, 0, 0, 1).
    AffineTransform3D(m: Matrix4x4): AffineTransform3D
        => AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3(
            Number3(m.Row1.X, m.Row1.Y, m.Row1.Z),
            Number3(m.Row2.X, m.Row2.Y, m.Row2.Z),
            Number3(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y, m.Row3.Z),
            Number3(m.Row4.X, m.Row4.Y, m.Row4.Z)));

    // Apply the affine map to a point: row-vector product
    // p' = x Row1 + y Row2 + z Row3 + Row4.
    Transform(p: Point3D, a: AffineTransform3D): Point3D {
        var m = a.Matrix;
        var v = m.Row1 * p.X + m.Row2 * p.Y + m.Row3 * p.Z + m.Row4;
        return (v.X, v.Y, v.Z);
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): a * p.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => Transform(p, a);

    // Apply the linear part to a displacement (the translation row is skipped).
    Transform(v: Vector3D, a: AffineTransform3D): Vector3D {
        var m = a.Matrix;
        var r = m.Row1 * v.X + m.Row2 * v.Y + m.Row3 * v.Z;
        return (r.X, r.Y, r.Z);
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): a * v.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform3D, v: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => Transform(v, a);

    // The affine transform that applies `first`, then `second`, computed
    // through the homogeneous forms.
    Compose(first: AffineTransform3D, second: AffineTransform3D): AffineTransform3D
        => (first.Matrix4x4 * second.Matrix4x4).AffineTransform3D;

    // Alias for Compose, enabling the * operator: a * b applies a first.
    Multiply(a: AffineTransform3D, b: AffineTransform3D): AffineTransform3D
        => a.Compose(b);

    // The inverse map. Precondition: CanInvert (a non-zero determinant).
    Inverse(a: AffineTransform3D): AffineTransform3D
        => a.Matrix4x4.Invert.AffineTransform3D;

    // True when the affine map is invertible (non-zero determinant).
    CanInvert(a: AffineTransform3D): Boolean
        => a.Matrix4x4.CanInvert;

    // Any TRS transform is affine.
    AffineTransform3D(t: TrsTransform3D): AffineTransform3D
        => t.Matrix4x4.AffineTransform3D;

    // Any rigid pose is affine.
    AffineTransform3D(pose: Pose3D): AffineTransform3D
        => pose.Matrix4x4.AffineTransform3D;

    // Any quaternion rotation is affine.
    AffineTransform3D(q: Quaternion): AffineTransform3D
        => q.Matrix4x4.AffineTransform3D;

    //==
    // Projective transforms — full homographies on homogeneous coordinates;
    // the widest transform family here, closed under composition.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homography

    // The product of two 3x3 matrices (row times column). Also discharges the
    // IMultiplicative obligation on Matrix3x3.
    Multiply(a: Matrix3x3, b: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3 {
        var c1 = Number3(b.Row1.X, b.Row2.X, b.Row3.X);
        var c2 = Number3(b.Row1.Y, b.Row2.Y, b.Row3.Y);
        var c3 = Number3(b.Row1.Z, b.Row2.Z, b.Row3.Z);
        return (Number3(a.Row1.Dot(c1), a.Row1.Dot(c2), a.Row1.Dot(c3)),
                Number3(a.Row2.Dot(c1), a.Row2.Dot(c2), a.Row2.Dot(c3)),
                Number3(a.Row3.Dot(c1), a.Row3.Dot(c2), a.Row3.Dot(c3)));
    }
```
